findings.title: Where the error lives
findings.read: Rate is the larger source of error (49.86 yds from volume vs 55.04 from rate). Fix the rate model first; tuning the other half cannot recover this.

findings.title: Volume bias
findings.read: We OVER-project attempts by 0.05 per player (projected 29.47, actual 29.42).

findings.title: Rate bias
findings.read: yards per attempt is under-projected by 0.08 (projected 7.18, actual 7.26).

findings.title: Opponent adjustment is costing accuracy
findings.read: Error with the adjustment 66, without it 63.92. Removing it would be more accurate on this sample.

findings.title: Against the closing line
findings.read: Beat the line on 7/26 (26.92%). Our MAE 66 vs the line's 54.69. The book is the better projection.
